VIMS (Vendor Invoice Management System) A Vendor Invoice Management (VIM) system is secure online platform, designed to streamline the process of managing invoices from vendors. It ensures efficient invoice capture, approval, and payment processing within an organization. The system integrates with enterprise resource planning (ERP) platforms like SAP t o centralize financial data and Government e Market place (GeM Portal). Invoices from vendors are upload ed with respect to purchase orders and goods receipts and services ordered and consumed. It also provide s transparency, allowing for better tracking, auditing, and reporting. Successful bidder is advised to upload complete set of Payment related documents as mentioned i n GeM Bid at VIMS portal of RCF (https://vims.rcfltd.com/).
